plain_text:
Ed Gardner appears in 139 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1939 to 1951. The credits here include performer, director, producer, and radio adaptor.

In this archive, you will hear Ed Gardner most often in Duffy's Tavern, Columbia Workshop, The Railroad Hour, Sealtest Variety Theater, The Big Show, and The Fred Allen Show.

Characters credited here include Archie.
